title: Idempotency record (idempotency_keys.status)
caption: src/common/http/idempotency.service.ts. Scope = <environment>:<principal>:<operationId>; the same key with another request hash is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; stored answers live 24 h (retention.daily deletes them after expires_at).

states.label: processing
states.detail: Claimed in a short transaction with a 2-minute lease (`locked_until`) renewed every 30 s. A duplicate waits up to 60 s, then replays or answers `409 CONFLICT idempotency_key_in_use`; a dead lease is taken over.

states.label: completed
states.detail: 2xx stored (and a 504 linked to a pending booking): `response_body` redacted; tokens, cookies and unmasked data only in `response_ciphertext`. Replays answer from it.

states.label: failed
states.detail: A final 4xx stored and replayed as such.

states.label: record deleted
states.detail: Transient answers (429, 503, 502 PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ERROR, other 5xx) delete the record so the same key can be sent again.

transitions.label: client retries with the same key
